body.text_en: And there is no living creature on earth whose sustenance is not the responsibility of Allah.
Indeed I have seen eleven stars and the sun and the moon prostrating to me.
Joseph and his brother are more beloved to our father than we, while we are a clan
If you are grateful, I will surely increase you in favor; but if you deny, indeed, My punishment is severe
Indeed, it is We who sent down the Reminder, and indeed, We will be its guardian.
Invite to the way of your Lord with wisdom and beautiful preaching, and argue with them in ways that are best and most gracious
And Allah's is the loftiest similitude
So do not strike likenesses for Allah, for He knows and you do not
All that is with you is bound to come to an end, whereas all that which is with Allah is everlasting.
And We never punish until We have sent a messenger

variants.text_en: We do not punish until We have sent a messenger

body.text_en: They are asking thee concerning the Spirit. Say: The Spirit is by command of my Lord, and of knowledge ye have been vouchsafed but little.

body.arabic: ‏ثُمَّ نُنَجِّى ٱلَّذِينَ ٱتَّقَوا۟ وَّنَذَرُ ٱلظَّلِمِينَ فِيهَا جِثِيًّۭا ‎
body.text_en: summa-n-najji-l-ladhina-t-taqaw wa nadharu-z-zalimina fiha jithiyya (Then We will save those who feared Allah and leave the wrongdoers within it, kneeling).
All praise is for Allah, Lord of the worlds.
Master of the Day of Judgment.
Guide us to the straight path
Taha
As We began the first creation, We shall repeat it

body.arabic: ‏إِذْ قَالَ لِأَبِيهِ وَقَوْمِهِۦ مَا هَذِهِ ٱلتَّمَاثِيلُ ٱلَّتِىٓ أَنتُمْ لَهَا عَكِفُونَ ‎
body.text_en: What are these statues to which you are devoted?
And for every nation We have appointed a rite

We created the human being from a quintessence of clay. Then We made him into a sperm-drop in a secure place. Then We made the drop into a clinging clot, and We made the clot into a lump, and We made the lump into bones, and We clothed the bones with flesh; then We brought him forth as another creation. So blessed is Allah, the best of creators

body.arabic: ‏فَتَقَطَّعُوٓا۟ أَمْرَهُم بَيْنَهُمْ زُبُرًۭا ۖ كُلُّ حِزْبٍۭ بِمَا لَدَيْهِمْ فَرِحُونَ ‎
body.text_en: `Kullu hizbin bima ladayhim farihun` (Each party rejoicing in that which is with them)
the Light of the heavens and the earth
wa-andhir 'ashirataka 'l-aqrabin (And warn your nearest kindred)
Indeed, it is from Solomon, and indeed, it reads: 'In the name of Allah, the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful'

And a man came running from the farthest end of the city. He said, 'Moses, the chiefs are taking counsel about you to slay you; so depart. Indeed, I am of those who counsel you well.' So he left the city, fearful and vigilant, saying, 'My Lord, save me from the wrongdoing people'

body.arabic: ‏وَقَالُوا۟ لَن يَدْخُلَ ٱلْجَنَّةَ إِلَّا مَن كَانَ هُودًا أَوْ نَصَرَىٰ ۗ تِلْكَ أَمَانِيُّهُمْ ۗ قُلْ هَاتُوا۟ بُرْهَنَكُمْ إِن كُنتُمْ صَدِقِينَ ‎
body.text_en: `haatu burhanakum in kuntum sadiqin` (Bring forth your proof, if you are truthful)

body.arabic: ‏ وَإِذِ ٱبْتَلَىٰٓ إِبْرَهِۦمَ رَبُّهُۥ بِكَلِمَتٍۢ فَأَتَمَّهُنَّ ۖ قَالَ إِنِّى جَاعِلُكَ لِلنَّاسِ إِمَامًۭا ۖ قَالَ وَمِن ذُرِّيَّتِى ۖ قَالَ لَا يَنَالُ عَهْدِى ٱلظَّلِمِينَ ‎
body.text_en: And We made him an Imam for mankind
when Ibrahim raised the foundations of the House. And Isma'il. 'Our Lord, accept from us.'

variants.text_en: And when Abraham was raising the foundations of the House, and Ishmael, 'Our Lord, accept from us. Indeed, You are the Hearing, the Knowing.'

body.text_en: Indeed we belong to Allah and to Him we shall return
When it is said to them, follow what Allah has sent down, they say, rather we will follow what we have found our fathers following
Those are the messengers; We preferred some of them over others.
La ikraha fi al-din (There is no compulsion in religion).

variants.text_en: qad tabayyana al-rushdu min al-ghayy (the right course has become distinct from the wrong).

body.text_en: And fear a Day when you will be returned to Allah. Then every soul will be paid in full what it has earned, and they will not be wronged.
O you who have believed, when you contract a debt for a specified term, write it down.

And when your Lord said to the angels, "I am going to place a caliph on the earth," they said, "Will You place in it one who corrupts it and sheds blood, while we glorify You with praise and sanctify You?" He said, "I know what you do not know."
So prostrate... so they prostrated, except for Iblis. He refused and was arrogant and was among the disbelievers.

body.arabic: ‏فَأَزَلَّهُمَا ٱلشَّيْطَنُ عَنْهَا فَأَخْرَجَهُمَا مِمَّا كَانَا فِيهِ ۖ وَقُلْنَا ٱهْبِطُوا۟ بَعْضُكُمْ لِبَعْضٍ عَدُوٌّۭ ۖ وَلَكُمْ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ مُسْتَقَرٌّۭ وَمَتَعٌ إِلَىٰ حِينٍۢ ‎
body.text_en: `aduwwun ba`dukum li-ba`din `aduww` (You are enemies, one to another)
Then Adam received from his Lord [certain] words

variants.text_en: Indeed, it is He who is the Accepter of repentance, the Merciful

body.text_en: Descend from it, all of you
Whoever is grateful is grateful for the good of his own soul
Indeed, Allah desires only to remove from you all impurity, O People of the Household, and to purify you with a thorough purification.
Our Lord, we obeyed our chiefs and our great ones, and they misled us from the way
Verily, Shaytan is your enemy, so treat him as your enemy.
Yasin
That is the decree of the Exalted in Might, the All-Knowing
It is not for the sun to overtake the moon, nor does the night outstrip the day; and each is swimming in an orbit.
His command, when He intends a thing, is only to say to it 'Be,' and it is
O you who believe, fear Allah as He should be feared, and die not except in a state of submission
Allah witnesses that there is no deity except Him
that they would make it clear to the people and not conceal it
That is because they said, "Never will the Fire touch us, except for a few numbered days," and they were deluded in their religion by what they used to invent.
So how will it be when We gather them for a Day about which there is no doubt, and every soul will be compensated for what it earned, and they will not be wronged?

Say, "O Allah, Owner of Sovereignty, You give sovereignty to whom You will and You take sovereignty away from whom You will. You honor whom You will and You humble whom You will. In Your hand is [all] good. Indeed, You are over all things competent".

Let not the believers take disbelievers for their friends in preference to believers. Whoever does that has no connection with Allah unless you but guard yourselves against them, taking, as it were, security.

When Allah said, "O Isa, indeed I will take you and raise you to Myself and purify you from those who disbelieve and make those who follow you superior to those who disbelieve until the Day of Resurrection."
and no one knows its interpretation except Allah and those well-grounded in knowledge

It is not for a human [prophet] that Allah should give him the Scripture and authority and prophethood and then he would say to the people, 'Be servants to me rather than Allah.' Rather, [he would say], 'Be pious scholars of the Lord because of what you have taught of the Scripture and because of what you have studied.'
Our Lord, let not our hearts deviate after You have guided us, and grant us from Yourself mercy. Indeed, You are the Bestower
And he would not order you to take the angels and prophets as lords. Would he order you to disbelief after you had submitted?

And [recall] when Allah took the covenant of the prophets, [saying], "Whatever I give you of the Scripture and wisdom and then there comes to you a messenger confirming what is with you, you [must] believe in him and support him."
He said, "Have you acknowledged and taken upon that My commitment?" They said, "We have acknowledged." He said, "Then bear witness, and I am with you among the witnesses."
And whoever turns away after that - then those are the defiantly disobedient.
Our Lord, surely You will gather the people for a Day about which there is no doubt. Indeed, Allah does not fail in His promise
You will not attain righteousness until you spend from that which you love. And whatever you spend - indeed, Allah is Knowing of it.
All food was lawful to the Children of Israel except what Israel had made unlawful to himself before the Torah was revealed. Say, "So bring the Torah and recite it, if you should be truthful."
Then whoever invents falsehood about Allah after that - it is those who are the wrongdoers.
that the people of Joseph said, when he died, that Allah would never raise a messenger after him

body.arabic: ‏وَقَالَ رَبُّكُمُ ٱدْعُونِىٓ أَسْتَجِبْ لَكُمْۚ إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يَسْتَكْبِرُونَ عَنْ عِبَادَتِى سَيَدْخُلُونَ جَهَنَّمَ دَاخِرِينَ ‎
body.text_en: Call upon Me; I will respond to you. Indeed, those who are too arrogant to worship Me will enter Hell in humiliation.
Who is better in speech than one who calls to Allah, works righteousness, and says, 'I am of those who submit'?
And of His signs are the night, the day, the sun, and the moon.
We will show them Our Signs in the universe and in their own selves, until it becomes manifest to them that this is the truth
There is nothing whatsoever like Him, and He is the All-Hearing, the All-Seeing
He has prescribed for you of the religion that which He enjoined upon Noah
It is We who distribute their means of livelihood — their sustenance — among them in the life of this world.
Verily, the noblest of you in the sight of Allah is the one who is most deeply conscious — most fearful — of Him.
if a transgressor brings them news they should investigate, lest they harm a people in ignorance and then become regretful
They did not kill him, nor did they crucify him, but it was made to appear so to them.

variants.text_en: and they did not kill him, nor did they crucify him, but [another] was made to resemble him for them

body.text_en: mankind would have no argument against Allah after the messengers
Wa fi anfusikum afala tubsirun (And in your own selves. Will you not then see?)
And of all things We created two mates; perhaps you will remember
laysa lil-insani illa ma sa'a
Indeed, We have created everything according to a measure
Every day He is in [some] affair.
The forerunners, the forerunners, those are the ones brought near.
None touch it except the purified.
the First and the Last, and the Ascendant and the Intimate, and He is, of all things, Knowing
O People of the Scripture, there has come to you Our Messenger to make clear to you after a period of messengers
And recite to them the story of Adam's two sons, in truth, when they both offered a sacrifice [to Allah], and it was accepted from one of them but was not accepted from the other.
al-yawma akmaltu lakum dinakum wa-atmamtu 'alaykum ni'mati (This day I have perfected for you your religion and completed My favor upon you)
did not forbid one another from wrongdoing they used to commit; evil indeed was the thing they did
He is the One who sent among the unlettered a Messenger from themselves, reciting to them His verses and purifying them and teaching them the Book and wisdom, although they were before in clear error

variants.text_en: It is He who sent among the unlettered a Messenger

body.text_en: When the call is proclaimed for the prayer on the day of Jumu'ah, then hasten to the remembrance of Allah and leave trade
Nun. By the pen and what they inscribe
Can he who was dead, to whom We gave life, and a light by which he can walk amongst men, be like him who is in the depths of darkness from which he can never come out?

body.arabic: ‏ وَإِذْ قَالَ إِبْرَهِيمُ لِأَبِيهِ آزَرَ أَتَتَّخِذُ أَصْنَامًا آلِهَةً ۖ إِنِّىٓ أَرَىٰكَ وَقَوْمَكَ فِى ضَلَلٍۢ مُّبِينٍۢ ‎
body.text_en: Azar raised him
But as for the one who has stood in awe of his Sustainer's Presence and restrained his inner self from base and evil desires, Paradise will be the place of rest.
show me, that I may look upon You
O reassured soul, return to your Lord, pleased and pleasing (verses 27 through 30)
And by the soul and Him who proportioned it, who inspired it with discernment of its corruption and its righteousness: successful is the one who purifies it, and lost is the one who corrupts it.
Take from their wealth a charity by which you purify them and cause them increase, and invoke the blessing of Allah upon them
